mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 3.5% over two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO below -0.5% for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in UNRATE above 4% and a fall in PAYEMS below 150000 for two consecutive months signals labor market imbalance with rising unemployment despite low slack, which increases uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 4% AND PAYEMS < 150000 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in HOUST below -5% for three consecutive months signals weakening housing demand, which negatively impacts construction and related sectors and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated fall in FEDFUNDS below 1% and a concurrent rise in CPIAUCSL above 3% YoY over one quarter signals a monetary policy-lag regime, where past easing coincides with rising inflation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% AND CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% in same quarter
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in RSAFS above 800 million for three consecutive months signals robust retail spending, which boosts consumer-facing equities and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 50% of triggered episodes.
